candidates.change_summary: Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = 0;' so that the value set is always zero, not the input.
Delete the assignment statement 'MinSum = _val;' so that MinSum remains unchanged (default 0) after the call.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = add_uint256(_val, 1);' so that the stored value is one more than the input.
Replace the modifier body so that it always reverts, preventing SetMinSum from ever executing its assignment.

Remove the 'require(!locked_);' check so that reentrancy is not prevented; this does not change MinSum directly but removes a possible revert; however, the key here is that by removing the guard, if the function is called reentrantly it may still execute; but to strictly change observable MinSum we alter the assignment path. Alternatively, replacing the modifier to skip the lock assignment: replace 'locked_ = true;' with nothing (i.e., delete that line) so that the reentrancy lock is never set, but that does not change MinSum. Instead, replace 'locked_ = true;' with 'locked_ = false;' so that the lock is never held, enabling reentrant calls but not changing MinSum directly. I choose to replace the modifier to always set locked_ to true and never reset, so that only one call ever succeeds and subsequent calls revert, but this does not change the MinSum value of the first call. To get a real change, I will replace the modifier to revert after '_' so that the state change is never finalized. Replace the line '_;' with 'revert();' so that after executing the function body the transaction reverts, and MinSum never updates.
Delete the line that sets MinSum, so MinSum remains zero.
Replace MinSum assignment with MinSum = 0, ignoring the argument.
Replace MinSum assignment with MinSum = _val + 1, changing the stored value.
Delete the 'if(intitalized)revert();' statement so that SetLogFile can be called even after initialization.
Replace the assignment of `intitalized` with false instead of true.
Replace the assignment to acc.balance with a subtraction instead of addition.
Delete the locked_ = false; line at the end of the nonReentrant_ modifier.
